summary_paragraph: Mr. ___ was readmitted two days after discharge due to recurrent malignant hypercalcemia, hyperglycemia, and acute kidney injury in the setting of relapsed refractory multiple myeloma. He was treated with IV fluids, a new cycle of chemotherapy with bortezomib, dexamethasone, and cyclophosphamide, and insulin therapy for steroid-induced hyperglycemia. During his stay, he developed a cough, and a chest X-ray revealed a left mid-zone infiltrate consistent with pneumonia. He was initially started on azithromycin but switched to levofloxacin due to transaminitis. His calcium, renal function, and glucose levels stabilized, and he was discharged home on oral levofloxacin, insulin, and his baseline medications with close follow-up arranged in oncology, endocrinology, and urology.
problems: Hypertensive chronic kidney disease with stage 1 through stage 4 chronic kidney disease, or unspecified chronic kidney disease
